title: Autumn Planting Catalogue
key_sentences: Everything in this catalogue is suitable for planting between September and December.
All seed is tested for germination each July and the result is printed on every packet.
A reliable softneck with large white bulbs that store until the following May.
Plant each clove with its tip just below the surface.
The classic autumn sowing, hardy to minus ten degrees.
It stores until March when dried properly.
Orders placed before 30 September are dispatched within three working days.

list_items.text: Sow 5 cm deep and 20 cm apart in a double row.
Cover with fleece during hard frosts.
Pinch out the growing tips when the first pods set to deter blackfly.
Fleece roll, 1.5 m by 10 m, with 12 pegs.
Glass cloche, set of two, with steel clips.
Bulb planter with a stainless steel blade.
